disposition: Completed explicit research derivation for owner verification/integration; no source theorem edit or acceptance claim

derivation.equation: a^ij D_ij u=f in B_R^+, u=0 on flat face; constant real symmetric lambda/Lambda-elliptic A, f C^alpha, 0<alpha<1; classical C2 approximants up to flat face.
derivation.estimate: sum(j=0..2) R^j ||D^j u||inf on B_R/2^+ + R^(2+alpha)[D2u]_alpha <= C(alpha,lambda,Lambda)(||u||inf on B_R^+ + R2||f||inf + R^(2+alpha)[f]_alpha). No zero flat-trace assumption on f.
critical_bridge: Extend the merely Hölder flat trace by a bounded explicit Hölder-metric infimum extension.
Construct L=(t^2/2)(rho_t*g); differentiate kernels rather than raw trace. Prove cancellation bounds |D^k g_t|<=C[g]_alpha t^(alpha-k), k1..3.
Prove L has zero Dirichlet and first jets, only normal-normal boundary second jet equal to g, and full C2alpha bound by a height/distance two-case argument.
Residual F=f-Delta L vanishes exactly on the flat face and has controlled C^alpha norm. The odd extensions are C2 for v=u-L and C^alpha for F; their matching boundary jets are verified.

Apply the actual proved Newtonian cancellation estimate to a fixed even cutoff of the residual. Its upper-half potential is exactly the reflected Green kernel. Localization introduces no unknown Du cutoff term.

Control harmonic remainder via mean-value convolution and smooth-kernel derivative estimates, then scale and reduce constant A via an explicit plane-preserving Schur-complement transform. A fixed neighborhood argument restores B_R/2 and its global Hessian seminorm.
no_extra_hypotheses: No tangential derivative of the raw C^alpha trace is taken.
No f=0 compatibility imposed on flat face.
No a priori C2alpha norm or higher smooth-approximant derivative bound used.
No incorrect transformation of a general ellipsoid into the same half-ball.
